_what: Build pipeline of the live Picta E11 lane (read 2026-10-17 from C:/1. AUTHORIA/_tools/picta-bridge). READ-ONLY map for adding an 'astralite colour blend' stage.

inputs.OLDM: mods/[NoDelete] Picta ENB 1.0.1 - Data (shipped)  (donor of every NON-colour number: weather medians by category, root fx values, base ini)
inputs.NEWM: mods/[NoDelete] Picta ENB 1.1.2 - Data (shipped)  (template: every file, all colour keys kept verbatim)
inputs.user_edits: _tools/picta-bridge/user_edits_*.json (glob, sorted, newest wins per key; {edits:{file:{SECTION:{key:value}}}}; asserts each key exists)

stages_in_order: 1 weather inis: for every NEWM enbseries/**/*.ini in a subfolder (not '_*', not 'Picta - Interiors'): copyable keys (single number, section != ENBEFFECTPOSTPASS.FX, key !~ /saturat|hue|tint|vibran|colou?r ?balance|filter/i) := median over category-matched 1.0.1 donors (same basename else category() = clear/light/cloudy/overcast/storm + rain/snow + fog from filename)
2 root fx inis (enbbloom/enbeffect/enbadaptation/enblens/enbsunsprite/enbunderwater/enbeffectprepass .fx.ini): non-colour numbers := 1.0.1 root value
3 base enbseries.ini: sections the weather files carry + [TIMEOFDAY]: non-colour numbers := 1.0.1 base; booleans stay 1.1.2
5 TRIM_EV = +0.2 on every 'Adaptation.|- * - Exposure Compensation (in EVs)' in weather inis + root enbadaptation.fx.ini
6 [TIMEOFDAY] 'Key=value' normalisation; FORCE EnableDepthOfField=true, DOF FocusingTime 0.5 / ApertureTime 5.0
7 Picta - Interiors/*.ini copied verbatim from NEWM (dead: not routed)
8 AMBIENT_GAIN = 1.15 x every AmbientLightingIntensity<period> + log2(1.15)=+0.2016 EV on every Exposure Compensation (weather inis, base ini, root enbadaptation; NOT _weatherlist / other root fx)
9 user_edits_*.json re-applied (base ini [EFFECT]/[BLOOM]/[ENVIRONMENT]/[LIGHTSPRITE]/[FIRE]/[WATER]; B01 IBL Day 0; A02 water waves)

10 overlay.apply(): global nudge (contrast +0.02, bloom-mix saturation +0.1 on Sunrise/Day/Sunset of A01/A02/B01/B02 masters) -> interior minimal files Authoria - Interiors/{House,Inn,Dungeon}.ini -> summer copies Authoria - Summer/{A01_Clear,A02_Clear_Mist,B01_Lightly_Cloudy}_Summer.ini DERIVED FROM THE (nudged) MASTER DATA IN THE PLAN + Day deltas -> _locationweather.ini [0] (961 bare lines) + readme -> _weatherlist sections WEATHER951/954/957/961/963/964 -> base [WEATHER] EnableLocationWeather=true
e11_layer.output: DSTM = mods/Authoria - Picta 1.1.2 - Darkened to 1.0.1 (enbseries.ini + enbseries/**). --write does shutil.rmtree(DSTM/enbseries) then writes the plan; aborts if ModOrganizer/SkyrimSE in tasklist. 'Picta - Weathers of Aurbis.ini' (plugin ini, 1.0.1 copy, fVolumetricLightingIntensity=0.0) and README/meta live in DSTM root and are NOT written by the builder.

shared_state_traps: The Darkened override mod is enabled in BOTH 'DEEZ CS NUTZ - PICTA' and 'Authoria - Preset Studio - HPH' - rebuilding it changes both lanes.

The Effects 11 editor Save writes through the VFS into whichever mod owns each file (base ini/root fx/current weather ini -> Darkened override; enbeffectpostpass.fx.ini -> shipped 1.1.2 Data mod; enbdepthoffield.fx.ini -> July DOF mod). A baby profile that only shadows SOME files would leak editor saves into the Picta lane's mods.

Root twin is one mod folder deployed to the game root by Root Builder; it must mirror the active profile's base ini + 4 fx inis. A baby profile whose base/fx inis differ needs its own twin mod (and the Picta twin disabled there).
Summer E11 files are generated from master data INSIDE the v3 plan; a downstream blend that edits only 00_Master files leaves summer weathers (5AFA01..) on pure Picta colours.
